inspector.modality: Native MRI, original publisher surfaces and exact categorical-cell boundaries
inspector.title: Optic, pituitary and head/neck source anatomy
inspector.caption: Explore 94 additional named source classes in one SPL atlas subject: optic nerves, tracts and chiasm; pituitary source parts; regional hypothalamic classes; pineal body; and 75 head/neck classes. Compare original publisher surfaces with exact source-cell boundaries in native T1/T2. These are source references, with incomplete reporting coverage and unverified biological boundaries. Class 4084 retains an unresolved remote publisher-surface component.
inspector.attribution: SPL-PNL/NAC Brain Atlas: Michael Halle, Florin Talos, Marianna Jakab, Nikos Makris, Dominic Meier, Laurence Wald, Bruce Fischl, Ron Kikinis and collaborators. Source commit bec24db25aad5f7600e2df3becfb1f883e61ff56. Original native MRI and categorical label samples are retained. Primer’s marked adaptation derives exact label-cell boundaries and adds grouped native-image relationship controls, preserving source components without fitted registration or cleanup. Full original source notices and licensing terms accompany the reference. Additional marked adaptation, 2026-11-01: 94 additional named source classes, original publisher-surface and exact source-cell representations. Original surface positions, components and strip triangles are retained; no mesh cleanup or fitted registration is applied.
